# Academically

> > Academically provides comprehensive exam preparation and professional certification courses for healthcare professionals seeking to practice internationally, with specialized programs for doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and allied health professionals.

Academically Global is a leading platform offering licensing exam prep courses and career development programs for healthcare professionals migrating to Australia, UAE, and other international destinations. The platform covers medical licensing exams (USMLE, PLAB, AMC), pharmacy credentials (OPRA, PSI, SPLE), nursing (NCLEX), and allied health professions, alongside English proficiency training and clinical research certification.

## Key Topics

- Medical Licensing Exams
- Healthcare Professional Certification
- Australia Licensing
- USMLE/PLAB/AMC Exams
- Pharmacy Exams (OPRA, PSI, SPLE)
- NCLEX Nursing
- Clinical Research
- Drug Safety & Pharmacovigilance
- Medical Science Liaison (MSL)
- English Proficiency (IELTS, PTE, OET)
- Job Assistance Programs
- UAE & Dubai Healthcare
- Study Abroad Scholarships
- Allied Health Professions
- Professional Certification Programs

## Medical Licensing Exam Courses

- [Doctor Courses for USMLE, PLAB & AMC Exams](https://academically.com/doctor): Specialized doctor courses for USMLE, PLAB, and AMC international medical licensing exams.
- [Pharmacist Courses for OPRA, PSI, SPLE, DHA and MOH](https://academically.com/pharmacist): Pharmacist exam prep courses for OPRA, PSI, SPLE, DHA, and MOH licensing in Australia and UAE.
- [NCLEX Course for Registered Nurses](https://academically.com/nurses): NCLEX exam preparation course for nurses seeking registered nursing credentials in USA and Australia.
- [ADC Dentists Course for Australia](https://academically.com/dentist): ADC dental licensing course for dentists practicing in Australia with DHA and OMSB exam options.
- [APC Physiotherapists Course for Australia](https://academically.com/physiotherapist): APEP physiotherapy course for professional licensing in Australia and Middle East regions.
- [MLT & MLS Courses for DHA & AIMS Exams](https://academically.com/medical-laboratory-technologist): MLT and MLS courses for DHA and AIMS exams in Dubai and Australia for lab technologists.
- [AVE Course for Veterinary Doctors](https://academically.com/veterinary-doctor): Australasian Veterinary Examination course for veterinary doctors practicing in Australia.
- [COE Optometrist Course for Australia](https://academically.com/optometrist): COE exam optometrist course for professional licensing in Australia through OCANZ.
- [DOH Healthcare Professional Course for Abu Dhabi](https://academically.com/healthcare-professionals): DOH healthcare professional course for Abu Dhabi licensing with clinical and pharmacovigilance training.
- [Pharmacy Technician](https://academically.com/pharmacy-technician): Pharmacy technician certification for SPLE exams in Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Abu Dhabi.

## Career Development & Job Assistance

- [Healthcare Job Assistance Courses & Certificate Programs](https://academically.com/job-assistance-course): Job assistance and career training courses including MSL, drug safety, and clinical drug development programs.
- [Clinical Research Professional Courses for Researchers](https://academically.com/clinical-research-professional): Clinical research professional courses including drug development, MSL, and pharmacovigilance certification.
- [Biomedical Research Methodology Courses for Researchers](https://academically.com/research-methology): Biomedical research methodology courses including clinical drug development and pharmacovigilance training.
- [Study Abroad Scholarship Course for MS & PhD](https://academically.com/study-abroad-scholarship): Scholarship guidance for MS and PhD programs in Australia for healthcare professionals.
- [Scholarship Abroad Program for Healthcare Professionals](https://academically.com/scholarship-program): ASAP scholarship program offering fee waivers and funding for healthcare professionals studying abroad.

## English Proficiency & Language Training

- [English Proficiency Courses for IELTS, PTE & OET Exams](https://academically.com/english-proficiency-test): IELTS, PTE, and OET English proficiency exam prep courses for healthcare professionals abroad.
